training.note: The Brazil point estimate is the sum of the state nowcasts; its interval is calibrated from summed independent rolling-origin residuals.

lasso.note: Point metrics pool all rolling-origin horizons. Coverage is prequential: every interval uses only national residuals whose target week precedes that prediction's origin.

infogripe.note: Not yet backtested: dated InfoGripe vintages are being accumulated before the 50/50 weight and interval coverage are evaluated.

partial_sivep.note: Prospective age-zero evaluation. Predictions are immutable; outcomes are attached only after 84 days. Interval metrics use only rows for which an interval was frozen at issuance.
